title_fa: تدوینِ خودکارِ حرفه‌ای: جداسازیِ پس‌زمینهٔ ویدیو (RVM) روی کارت
note: The automatic video edit (director recipe 'polish') runs on the existing kinds: asr.transcribe (requirements.d/asr-gpu.json, words for the cuts / retakes / captions), edit.matte (background blur / solid colour / picture with Robust Video Matting) and edit.render (final render with NVENC); the faces that decide the framing and the look are found on the site (YuNet, a few milliseconds per shot). Its only own need is the RVM model (mobilenetv3, ONNX, 14 MB, GPL-3.0: run here only inside the node on the owner's own videos, never redistributed or linked) in <data>/models/video-matting - the python side (numpy, Pillow, OpenCV, onnxruntime-directml) comes from 'gpu-runtime'. Without this file the model was fetched lazily by the first edit.matte job; now it is there before the first video is edited. Mirror order: this site (3d/files/downloads), then the original GitHub release asset (same bytes, sha256 checked either way). `kinds` stays empty on purpose: a missing model never blocks the editor's other jobs, edit.matte falls back to the frame-by-frame path.
